turns.text: Hi there. How did today go, and what stood out for you?
Pretty good day honestly. I finally shipped the webhook retry worker for Daybook-style side project, the hackathon one.
Shipped the webhook retry worker for your hackathon project, that feels great. Did it fix any specific failure rates or time-outs? A rough number is fine, and not knowing is completely okay too.
Failed deliveries went from about 1,200 a day to under 100.
Dropping from about twelve hundred to under a hundred failed deliveries is huge. How did the retry worker work under the hood?
Also spent an hour helping a friend debug her first open source PR.
Helping a friend debug her first open source PR is such a kind thing to do. Did she end up getting the PR merged successfully?
She got it merged by the evening, she was really happy.
That must have felt so good to see her pull request get merged. What was the hardest part of your day today?
You shipped the webhook retry worker and debugged the open source PR. Tomorrow I'll ask how you did shipped webhook retry worker. Did I miss anything?
Thanks, that's saved. Have a good evening.
